note: rosanna (Rosanna, BASE unit — NOT rosanna-chic-ocean the AR/Wind Supporter variant; do NOT conflate) — MG / Attacker / Electric / Burst I, cd 40s. A concealment-and-Frenzy burst DPS whose kit is heavily PVE-survival/utility oriented: most of her lines (Concealment targeting-prevention x3, enemy buff-removal, two ally-death Frenzy/damage triggers) are OUT-OF-DOMAIN for the immortal-boss / no-targeting DPS basis and are documented verbatim in `unmodeled`. The DPS-load-bearing lines that ARE modeled: (S1-crit) after landing 120 normal attacks -> self Critical Rate ▲19.34% for 3 sec -> hitCount:120 -> self critRatePct 19.34 / durationSec 3 (UNSCOPED critRatePct, kit says plain 'Critical Rate', not 'of normal attacks'; recurs every 120 normals, no once-per-battle clause). (S1-elem) 'when the stage target appears ... Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲20% continuously' -> passive -> self elemAdvantageDamagePct 20 (engine gates it to the ELEMENT bucket and applies it ONLY while advantaged() — Electric beats Water, so it is live vs a Water boss and inert vs a non-advantaged boss; sim.ts advantaged()/elemAdvantageDamagePct). (S2-frenzy) 'after landing 500 normal attacks on the stage target -> Frenzy: ATK ▲22.61%, stacks up to 10, lasts 30 sec' -> hitCount:500 -> self atkPct 22.61 / maxStacks 10 / durationSec 30 (recurs every 500 normals; the OTHER Frenzy source — on ally incapacitation — is out-of-domain and unmodeled, so only the 500-normal stacks accrue here). (Burst-Assalto) 'Prioritizes Attacker-type enemies, 2 enemies: Assalto 1310.4% of final ATK' -> burstCast -> enemy flatDamage 1310.4 (single boss so '2 enemies / prioritize Attacker' collapses to the one target; burst-cast auto FB-exempt, snapshots pre-FB). (Burst-taken) 'if the target hit by Assalto is a Water Code stage target -> Damage Taken ▲29% for 30 sec' -> burstCast + bossElementGate:'Water' -> enemy damageTakenPct 29 / durationSec 30 (boss-held team-wide taken debuff; INERT vs a non-Water boss, awakes vs Water — same pattern as helm-aquamarine/brid-silent-track). UNMODELED (out-of-domain, verbatim): S1 Concealment (10s, targeting-prevention — no concealment primitive; boss deals no damage so targeting is irrelevant); S1 'Removes 5 buff(s). Activates once per battle' (enemy buff-removal not modeled); S2 battle-start Concealment (5s); S2 'when a Nikke is incapacitated -> Frenzy ATK ▲22.61% x10/30s + Fills Burst Gauge by 36.54%' (ally-death trigger never fires — immortal boss, no ally ever incapacitated); S2 'when a Nikke is incapacitated -> 400% of final ATK to 1 enemy' (same ally-death trigger). ⚑1 (OUT-OF-DOMAIN / MEASUREMENT-GATED, burst additional damage): burst line 'Activates when the skill user is in the Concealment state ... Deals 561.6% of final ATK as additional damage' is NOT modeled — it is gated on the Concealment SELF-STATE, which has no engine primitive (concealment is a targeting-prevention status, out-of-domain for DPS). Estimate: +561.6% of final ATK per burst ON TOP of the 1310.4% Assalto (≈ +43% burst damage) WHEN concealment is up; concealment uptime is itself unmeasured (S2 gives 5s at battle start, S1 gives 10s every 120 normals, so qualitatively high after the opening, but the exact burst-cast-phase overlap is a timing read). Recipe: needs a concealment self-status primitive (window keyed to the S1 120-normal / S2 battle-start sources) AND a burst-cast-timing popup read to pin the overlap; until then it is an honest gap, not a silent drop. Tier: out-of-domain (the gating state is a targeting mechanic the DPS sim does not represent) + measurement-gated (the precise uptime needs footage). RECONCILED vs the cross-family S2b reviewer (kimi-code/k3), which recommended encoding the 561.6% UNGATED + asserting ≈100% in-fixture concealment uptime via an inert marker buff: the reviewer is correct that IN-FIXTURE concealment uptime is ≈100% after the first 120-normal proc (MG cadence ~33 normals/s ⇒ 120 normals ≈ 3.6s proc interval < the 10s window, and the v1 boss deals no damage so 'removed upon taking a direct hit' never fires ⇒ continuous from ~3.6s, covering every 40s+ burst cast). But that ≈100% is a SIM ARTIFACT of the immortal/no-damage boss — in a real fight concealment BREAKS on every direct hit, so real uptime is strictly lower and is a timing read the sim cannot reproduce. Encoding ungated would therefore bake an unmeasured sim artifact into the damage total (fudge), whereas the honest ⚑ preserves 'measured > fudge'; the reviewer's own marker-buff workaround also needs an inert-stat hack (the schema has no concealment/self-status stat). Both positions are defensible; the driver picks the conservative honest gap. The reviewer's spec also OMITTED four real kit lines the driver models (S1 Elemental Advantage 20% = R1, S2 500-normal Frenzy = R3, burst Water-Code Damage Taken 29% = R5, S2 ally-death 400% = R7); these are independently re-derived by the S5/S6/S7 blind roles. ⚑2 cadence tuple: MG pulls/s + reloadFrames 121 + ammo 300 are datamined defaults, not yet measured from video; the hitCount:120 / hitCount:500 proc COUNTS scale with fire cadence, so a measured cadence would refine the absolute proc counts (the encoding — every 120 / every 500 normals — is kit-exact regardless). Recipe: rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video. TIER 2 (bossElementGate status-gate on the burst taken-debuff; scoped self-buffs; hitCount round-count cadence; concealment status-gate ⚑ on the additional damage).
